description: Contract lint for api/openapi/openapi.yaml, run by `make lint-spec` and the CI codegen job. The frontend generator keys on operationIds and the MSW contract test on documented JSON responses, so those rules are errors, not style advice.

operation-operationId.description: Every operation needs an operationId — openapi-typescript and the typed client key on it.

operation-summary.description: Operations carry a summary; the description documents non-obvious behavior.

operation-success-response.description: Every operation must document its success response.

operation-default-response.description: Every operation must declare its error response (the problem+json default).
